mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at the Verona Area High School with temperatures holding steady at 51 degrees.

City officials are reminding everyone that winter parking rules start November 20. Additionally, please keep an eye on your mail for upcoming cross-connection water inspections as the city updates safety measures.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, bring the family to the Main Street Trick or Treat at Hometown Junction Park and catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol or live music at Paddy Mac's.
In a notable call from October 25, a 40-year-old man was arrested for an O W I offence after being found stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is the decadent Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The restaurant is open and serving until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
